review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
review_candidates.description: Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software. About The Role Join our engineering software team to build our Enterprise Physics AI solution, a product that gives customers a complete workflow around physics AI models that cut simulation time from dayrs or hours to minutes or seconds. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll collaborate with software developers, AI and simulation specialists, and product managers to turn engineering needs and customer feedback into reliable, scalable, easy-to-use enterprise software. This role brings together software development and engineering knowledge, with opportunities to contribute across the development lifecycle and work with a range of technologies. What You’ll Do You’ll design, develop, and maintain software for engineering applications, creating code that is reliable, reusable, and easy to maintain. Working closely with development teams and product managers, you’ll turn engineering requirements and user needs into practical software solutions. As part of an Agile/Kanban environment, you’ll contribute to code reviews, development discussions, testing, debugging, and software improvements. You’ll take part in user testing and use feedback to improve applications and interfaces. You’ll also investigate technical issues, explore solutions, and contribute ideas that improve the quality and usability of our software. What You Bring A degree in Computer Eningeering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or a related technical field. Professional experience in software development, with the ability to take ownership of software solutions from development through delivery. Programming experience with Python and/or C++/Java, with Python particularly relevant to this role. Knowledge of data structures and algorithms, together with experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and engineering simulation processes. Experience with databases and microservices, and familiarity with technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Exposure to graph databases is a plus. Familiarity with tools such as Git, Jira, and Confluence, and the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with colleagues from different disciplines. Why Us? At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

review_candidates.title: Software Support Engineer (Full Stack)
review_candidates.description: We're looking for a Software Support Engineer (Full Stack) to help the top customers of a fast-growing AI app builder successfully build and scale their apps. The platform lets business owners describe the software they need in plain language and get a working product. Those customers are not technical, so when the platform's AI agent fails them, they are stuck. You are the person who gets them unstuck, whether that means fixing a bug, advising on architecture, or sorting out an integration. This is a support role for engineers. You will debug real production issues in customer apps, then take what you learn and fix the underlying platform or AI agent so the same issue never happens again. You will also build automations so your support workflow can scale to hundreds of customers a day. If you are a strong TypeScript and React engineer who likes talking to customers, moves fast, and cares about getting the details right, this role is a strong fit. Why You'll Want to Join You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th) Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy Observance of Holidays per company guidelines 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive This role requires working standard Sydney business hours Work on a modern stack with AI at the core of the product, across multiple cloud providers and AI models Stay in the role as long as you like, with an open path to transition into software engineering, pre-sales engineering, or post-sales engineering after 6 to 12 months What You'll Work On Customer App Resolution Fully resolve issues with customer apps, from fixing bugs to advising on architecture to helping with integrations Work with non-technical customers and explain problems and fixes in clear, simple language Debug production issues using logs, traces, repros, and minimal test cases Close tickets at high volume without sacrificing quality or leaving customers half-helped Product and Platform Improvement Turn every customer fix into a platform improvement by updating the underlying platform or AI agent so the issue does not recur Spot patterns across tickets and flag the product gaps that cause the most customer pain Work with the engineering team to ship fixes quickly and verify they work Knowledge Base and Documentation Keep public and internal documentation up to date, including known issues Write guides and answers that are clear, concise, and tailored to the audience Turn repeated questions into self-serve resources Support Automation Automate your support workflow so you can help hundreds of customers a day Build tooling, scripts, and AI-assisted workflows that cut repetitive work and speed up resolution Continuously improve how support runs rather than just working the queue Incident Response Be the first point of contact for platform incidents during your working hours Manage the public status page and customer communication during incidents Coordinate with engineering on diagnosis and resolution, and follow up with clear updates until it is closed What You Bring Strong TypeScript and React background Solid modern web app fundamentals including HTTP, APIs, authentication, and databases Proven ability to debug production issues using logs, traces, repros, and minimal test cases Strong systems and architecture thinking, including scalability, reliability, performance, and security basics Excellent written communication that is clear, simple, concise, and specific to the audience Prior experience in a customer-facing role such as support, sales, or pre-sales A track record of closing 50 or more tickets a day A bias to ship fast, iterate, and correct mistakes quickly Good taste and attention to detail, with pride in work that is simple and self-serve Hunger and a willingness to work hard and operate at any level to get things done Available to work standard Sydney business hours Nice to Have Experience with Postgres, Redis, ClickHouse, Hono, Drizzle ORM, Temporal, or Tailwind Experience with Cloudflare or AWS and infrastructure as code tools such as CDK or Terraform Experience building with AI SDKs and LLM-based applications Experience building automations or internal tooling to scale a support function Experience managing platform incidents and public status communication Experience supporting non-technical or small business customers How to Apply Please include: Your updated resume A GitHub link or example of work if you have one A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your engineering and customer-facing experience, and walking through a production issue you debugged from report to fix and what you changed so it would not happen again Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process. If you are an engineer who likes solving real problems for real customers, moves fast, and wants to help build a platform that makes software accessible to non-technical operators, this role gives you the ownership and the direct impact to do your best work. Application Process Overview Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients: Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable) Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.
